opening: You command an empire in a live, real-time 0 A.D. match against one opponent. The game never pauses for you. Win by conquest, or hold the highest score at the time cap. Read the brief, then give your orders with the tools.

tools.name: advance_phase
tools.description: Advance to the next phase (village, town, city) as soon as its requirements and resources allow.

tools.name: army
tools.description:
Set your army's posture: gather (soldiers work), attack or raid a player, defend a place, retreat home, or
scout.

action.description: gather, attack, raid, defend, retreat or scout.
action.title: Action

target.description: The target: a player (player_2 or 2), center, front or home.
target.title: Target

tools.name: build
tools.description: Place one building; villagers build it. The spot is found near the anchor `where` names.

where.description: Where to place it: base, front, near_<food|wood|stone|metal> or toward_<player> (e.g. toward_2).
where.title: Where

tools.name: research
tools.description: Research one technology by its engine name, at a building that offers it.

tools.name: say
tools.description: Say a short line in character, shown on the live overlay. Optional.

tools.name: set_economy
tools.description:
Split your gatherers between the four resources, in percent; the four must add up to 100. Idle and surplus
gatherers move over the next seconds.

tools.name: train
tools.description:
Train `count` more units of a role, mapped to your civilization's units; batches go to free buildings as
population room and resources allow.

role.description: villager, infantry_melee, infantry_ranged, cavalry, siege, champion
role.title: Role

count.description: How many more units of the role to train.
count.title: Count

at.description: Only at this kind of building, e.g. "barracks".
at.title: At

results.message: Economy split set: food 50%, wood 30%, stone 10%, metal 10%. Idle and surplus gatherers move over the next ticks.

A stable can't train infantry_melee; these can: army_camp, barracks, civil_centre.
